_deal: The live local-cargo pool, as every lettered recipe since 2026-10-12.
author: jessica
_note: TYPE 7, THE TALK VERB: THE SMALLEST TALK TEST. His 2026-10-12: "yeah think talk is the next major one".
Written 2026-10-10 on his "want to write a talk mission?"; made a recipe so the talk beat has a first
target. Only the talk beat is new: the pickup and the deliver are beats that have already played, so if it
breaks, it broke in the conversation (the page's 'why it is built this small').
PROPOSED, the same shape as 11a so one build serves both: a talk beat with person, greeting, exchanges.
Exchange 0 ends the conversation and sets the next stage (here the pickup; in 11a it ends the quest and takes
the item). Prompts <= 60 chars, replies <= 200 (docs/specs/npc_dialogue.md). Optional exchanges read in any
order; none relies on another. person.voice / person.elevenlabs are PROPOSED too: the person speaks, so the
voice belongs to the person, not to a radio speaker.
The talk beat speaks, so it has no message box; the pickup and deliver have boxes, nothing speaks there.
The page's board posting is held back: this deals from the slate pool, so the opening is the briefing.

place._theme: A quiet worked site for the site hand to be at (he is placed by the talk beat; NonHostile mostly has nobody). The drop is anywhere that is not a cave.

prose.name: Inquiry: Survey Crate on <Planet>
prose.briefing: A survey crew left their samples behind at the <Place>. A site hand there is holding them. I should go and ask him for the crate.

beats.objective: Talk to the site hand at the <Place>
beats.journal: The site hand says the crew left in a hurry and took his crate by mistake, lunch and all. Ours is still here. He's marked where.
beats.greeting: You're from the survey lot? Good. I've had their crate here for days and I've been told not to open it.

exchanges.prompt: I'm here for the survey crate.
exchanges.reply: Right. Your crew left in a hurry and took the wrong crate. Theirs had my lunch in it. Yours is still here. I've marked it for you.

exchanges.prompt: How long have you been out here?
exchanges.reply: Eleven years, on and off. Most weeks nobody comes out at all. You're the third this week.

exchanges.prompt: Why did the crew leave so fast?
exchanges.reply: A recall came in from their office and they were packed in an hour. Nothing bad. They were nice enough. Loud, but nice.
No. It says sealed, so it's sealed. I did shake it once. It rattles like rocks, which I suppose it is.

beats._talk: PROPOSED fields. Exchange 0 ends the conversation and sets the pickup's stage. Voiced lines: no names, no places.

message.title: Survey Crate
message.text: The crate is sealed and stencilled with a survey mark. Someone has written LUNCH on the lid in marker and crossed it out.

beats.objective: Deliver the survey crate to the <SecondPlace>
beats.journal: A survey crew left their samples at the <Place> and took a site hand's lunch by mistake. I collected the samples and delivered them to the <SecondPlace>.
beats.name: Survey Drop Locker

message.title: Delivered
message.text: The crate goes into the drop locker with its seal unbroken.
